reasons.claim: Each transmitter in the linear isnad is captured in order from al-Nasa'i's shaykh down to Ibn Abbas, whose report of the Prophet ends the chain.
reasons.quote: أخبرني محمد بن عبد الله بن عبد الحكم، عن أشهب، أن داود بن عبد الرحمن، حدثهم أن عمرو بن دينار حدثه أن عطاء بن أبي رباح حدثهم أنه، سمع ابن عباس، يقول أرسلني رسول الله

reasons.claim: The report cites an anonymous passive report with no named transmitter before the Imam, so it has no isnad.
reasons.quote: وقد روي في خبر آخر أن الصادق عليه السلام سئل

reviews.question: nested first-person isnads inside a narrated encounter

reasons.claim: All four opening isnads and the four co-transmitters in the first chain are accurately captured as seven routes ending at al-A'mash, with the wording remark omitted.
reasons.quote: وزاد بعضهم على بعض في اللفظ، وقال بعضهم ما لم يقل بعض، وسياق الحديث لمندل بن علي العنزي، عن الاعمش

reasons.claim: Reader A flagged the nested first-person chains inside the story as needing a ruling; if such embedded chains are excluded the agreed reading is right as it stands, whereas if they were stored additional routes would be needed.
reasons.quote: حدثني والدي، عن أبيه، عن جده

reasons.claim: All six transmitters are captured in order, with the blessing omitted and the relation word before Musa b. Ja'far stripped.
reasons.quote: عن علي بن جعفر، عن أخيه موسى بن جعفر قال

reasons.claim: All five transmitters are captured in order, and the dashed gloss by Ahmad b. Salih is rightly excluded.
reasons.quote: - قال أحمد بن صالح كلاما معناه أنه مولى ابن عباس - عن عبد الله بن عباس

reasons.claim: The three co-transmitters joined by جميعاً form one level converging on Sa'd al-Iskaf, and Abu Ja'far named after the chain is the last link before the Prophet.
reasons.quote: عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ وَ زَيْدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ وَ عَبَّادٍ جَمِيعاً عَنْ سَعْدٍ الْإِسْكَافِ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ

reasons.claim: All six transmitters are captured in order as written, including bare Muhammad and al-Qasim, down to A'isha.
reasons.quote: أخبرنا محمد بن بشار، قال حدثنا محمد، قال حدثنا شعبة، قال سمعت عبد الرحمن بن القاسم، قال سمعت القاسم، يحدث عن عائشة

reviews.question: bare kunya speaker inside a narrated dialogue

reasons.claim: All six transmitters are captured in order with the relation words stripped from the named relatives.
reasons.quote: حدثني أبي عيسى بن محمد عن أبيه محمد بن علي بن جعفر عن أبيه علي بن جعفر عن أخيه موسى بن جعفر

reasons.claim: Reader B flagged the internal speaker Abu al-Hasan as needing a ruling; if an internal bare-kunya speaker in the dialogue is not added as a link, the agreed reading is right as it stands.
reasons.quote: قال أبو الحسن: فقلت له: يا سيدي

reasons.claim: All five transmitters written before the trailing ح are captured in order, with no second branch written in this text.
reasons.quote: وحدثنا محمد بن رافع، حدثنا عبد الرزاق، حدثنا معمر، عن همام بن منبه، عن  أبي هريرة، ح

reasons.claim: All five transmitters are captured in order with the date gloss omitted, and Abu Abd Allah who answers Hamran inside the report is rightly added as the last link.
reasons.quote: عن حمران بن أعين أنه قال: وصفت لأبي عبد الله رجلاً
